_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dev_identity" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dev_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "institutions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "institution_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES institutions (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "market" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_class" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL, "isin" TEXT NULL, "sector" TEXT NULL, "segment" TEXT NULL, "liquidity" TEXT NULL, "price_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fixed_income_terms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "product" TEXT NOT NULL, "issuer" TEXT NULL, "indexer" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "spread" TEXT NULL, "day_count" TEXT NOT NULL, "issue_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "maturity_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "grace_until" TEXT NULL, "liquidity" TEXT NOT NULL, "tax_regime" TEXT NOT NULL, "costs_notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "trade_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "settlement_date" TEXT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NULL, "unit_price" TEXT NULL, "gross_amount" TEXT NULL, "fees" TEXT NOT NULL, "taxes" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "fx_rate" TEXT NULL, "ratio_from" TEXT NULL, "ratio_to" TEXT NULL, "transfer_group_id" TEXT NULL, "related_operation_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES operations (id), "justification" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "manual_valuations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "ref_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "canonical_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hypo_portfolios" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "objective" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_capital" TEXT NOT NULL, "composition_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "benchmark_json" TEXT NULL, "rebalance_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "assumptions_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "methodology" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "duplicated_from_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hypo_holdings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "portfolio_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hypo_portfolios (id), "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "weight_pct" TEXT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hypo_cashflow_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "portfolio_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hypo_portfolios (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, "pct" TEXT NULL, "adjustment" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hypo_scenarios" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "portfolio_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES hypo_portfolios (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "assumptions_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dev_sync_peers" ("peer_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "peer_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_hlc_received" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_hlc_sent" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("peer_device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dev_sync_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "peer_device_id" TEXT NULL, "peer_name" TEXT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "max_hlc" TEXT NULL, "counts_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dev_backups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "encryption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_prices" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "market" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "open" TEXT NULL, "high" TEXT NULL, "low" TEXT NULL, "close" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_factor" TEXT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "market", "ref_date", "source", "data_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_quotes" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "market" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "delay_note" TEXT NULL, "data_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "market", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_corporate_events" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "market" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ex_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" TEXT NOT NULL, "com_date" TEXT NULL, "payment_date" TEXT NULL, "factor" TEXT NULL, "amount" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_label" TEXT NULL, "isin" TEXT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "market", "event_kind", "ex_date", "source", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_indicators" ("series_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("series_code", "ref_date", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_fx_rates" ("base" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "bid" TEXT NULL, "ask" TEXT NULL, "ref_at" TEXT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("base", "quote", "ref_date", "kind", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_treasury_prices" ("title" TEXT NOT NULL, "maturity_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "buy_rate" TEXT NULL, "sell_rate" TEXT NULL, "buy_pu" TEXT NULL, "sell_pu" TEXT NULL, "base_pu" TEXT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("title", "maturity_date", "ref_date", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_fund_quotas" ("cnpj" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "quota" TEXT NULL, "nav" TEXT NULL, "holders" TEXT NULL, "isin" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cnpj", "ref_date", "kind", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mkt_instruments" ("symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "market" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "isin" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "collected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("symbol", "market", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dev_provider_state" ("provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_success_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "quota_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "quota_period" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider"));
CREATE INDEX shared_settings_hlc ON shared_settings (hlc)
CREATE INDEX shared_settings_key ON shared_settings ("key")
CREATE INDEX institutions_hlc ON institutions (hlc)
CREATE INDEX institutions_name_key ON institutions (name_key)
CREATE INDEX accounts_hlc ON accounts (hlc)
CREATE INDEX accounts_institution ON accounts (institution_id)
CREATE INDEX assets_hlc ON assets (hlc)
CREATE INDEX assets_symbol ON assets (symbol, market)
CREATE INDEX fixed_income_terms_hlc ON fixed_income_terms (hlc)
CREATE INDEX fixed_income_terms_asset ON fixed_income_terms (asset_id)
CREATE INDEX operations_hlc ON operations (hlc)
CREATE INDEX operations_asset_date ON operations (asset_id, trade_date)
CREATE INDEX operations_account_date ON operations (account_id, trade_date)
CREATE INDEX operations_date ON operations (trade_date)
CREATE INDEX manual_valuations_hlc ON manual_valuations (hlc)
CREATE INDEX manual_valuations_asset_date ON manual_valuations (asset_id, ref_date)
CREATE INDEX asset_aliases_hlc ON asset_aliases (hlc)
CREATE INDEX asset_aliases_alias ON asset_aliases (alias_id)
CREATE INDEX hypo_portfolios_hlc ON hypo_portfolios (hlc)
CREATE INDEX hypo_holdings_hlc ON hypo_holdings (hlc)
CREATE INDEX hypo_holdings_portfolio ON hypo_holdings (portfolio_id)
CREATE INDEX hypo_cashflow_rules_hlc ON hypo_cashflow_rules (hlc)
CREATE INDEX hypo_scenarios_hlc ON hypo_scenarios (hlc)
